audit.title: Firmware Freeze Audit — Four-Piece Set, Post-5.28-Erlangen
audit.baseline_rationale: Last commit touching any of the four pieces' sources before the 2026-05-28 Erlangen capture (commit 1936d01c3). The two intervening 05-26 commits (1c4954760, 5059314b3) were field-UI only. ae3d3e391 is an ancestor of HEAD (clean linear diff).

baseline_markers.tag: alt-bcast-b69-imu-rawxyz-tspoll-g1200-r1000 (b69 raw-IMU line; deployed to BS2DCE/BSDC91/etc for Erlangen)
baseline_markers.anchor_deployed: us-hc-exp4-tail900-start5 (tail-compressed F/G/H@900us, ultrasound; confirmed x76 in erlangen_20260528_optitrack logs)

class_definitions.KEEP: Proven useful / required for ranging. In frozen baseline, default ON.
class_definitions.RUNTIME-DEBUG: Useful only for debug/experiments. Must be runtime-toggleable and default OFF (or a knob locked to production value).
class_definitions.USELESS: Proven no value. Remove/revert. (Dead scaffolding here is already removed by the diff; falsified experiments remain compile-gated OFF.)

audit.hot_path_verdict: In the frozen production config (all RUNTIME-DEBUG OFF): the tag RX collector and the anchor responder execute NO per-frame dwt_readdiagnostics / LDE_THRESH / AGC_STAT1 SPI reads — they compile out. The responder transmits the V1 20-byte frame (= a18 good-timing baseline). Hot path is clean of the DIAG regression. It is NOT byte-identical to 5.28 because of two deliberate KEEP timing changes (TAIL_MARGIN 300→800us, which is what enabled ge8; broadcast_tdma slot-boundary hardening) plus CPU-only phase-telemetry hooks (default ON, no SPI). See open_items for the default-ON diagnostics the operator should confirm.

changes.change: P0 TX-RF: dwt_configuretxrf() CH5/PRF64 (PGdly=TC_PGDELAY_CH5=0xC0, power=0x25456585) via new ss_twr_init_apply_txrf_and_diag(), called ONCE from ss_twr_init_configure_radio() (init-only, not hot path)
changes.class_confidence: KEEP on determinism/compliance grounds, NOT a proven ranging fix
changes.evidence: Verified fact (both audits): dwt_configuretxrf() was never called before, so TX_POWER(0x1E)/TC_PGDELAY(0x2A:0x0B) sat at silicon POR. BUT the 2026-07-10 science_audit (logs/science_audit_20260710/AUDIT_REPORT.md 1b) found the POR values were already the DW1000-UM-recommended Ch5/PRF64 smart-TX values ('acceptable'); the written PGdly 0xC0 EQUALS the Ch5 POR (effective no-op); Smart-TX => 0.0dB poll/resp differential. The ge7 REGRESSION_REPORT explicitly CLEARS P0 of the regression ('not the P0 dwt_configuretxrf change itself'); no A/B ranging gain was demonstrated and logs/p0txrf_bootreadback/ is empty. KEEP justification = deterministic/known register state across chip batches (removes the 2026-07-06 DW1000_REGISTER_AUDIT 'left at POR' gap) + it carries the genuine fix T20 (DIS_AM). Benign-but-tidy, init-only.

changes.change: SS_TWR_INIT_ALT_BCAST_TAIL_MARGIN_US 300 -> 800
changes.evidence: Inline comment: '300us closed the collector window ~235us early, so anchor 7 (last responder) was dropped systematically, capping every sweep at ge7 and making ge8 near-impossible.' This is the ge8 enabler. Corroborated by FREEZE_A18_REVERIFIED_8ANCHOR_20260701.md (ge8=0.972).

changes.change: Broadcast Alt-SSTWR production config as CMake defaults: ALT_SS_TWR_ENABLE 0->1, ALT_SS_TWR_BCAST_ENABLE 0->1, GUARD_US 400->1200, BCAST_FORCE_FULL_SWEEP 0->1, LIGHT_TDMA_ENABLE 0->1
changes.evidence: Encodes the deployed g1200-r1000 broadcast protocol (was passed via -D at 5.28; now the default). Required for ranging.

changes.change: TDMA 10Hz defaults: SLOT_PERIOD_MS 25->10, SLOT_ACTIVE_MS 20->9
changes.evidence: Production 10Hz operation (position-high/overnight-power runs). Matches master 10x9.

changes.evidence: TR;2 is the current host-parsed range line. Host capture pipeline consumes this format.

changes.change: broadcast_tdma slot-boundary hardening: late-tolerance / min-remain(12ms) / spin-threshold(3ms) knobs + multi-slot-mask + busy-wait-near-slot in broadcast_tdma_wait_next_slot_start()
changes.evidence: Inline comment: an 8-anchor broadcast sweep can overrun into the next tag when the thread wakes late; starts a burst only at an owned slot boundary with enough active budget. Prevents cross-tag overrun.

changes.change: Runtime DIAG gate: ss_twr_init_rf_diag_runtime_on (default false) + set/get + BLE 'DIAG ON|OFF','DIAG?' commands; compile flag APP_TAG_RF_DIAG_TAG_RX_ENABLE (default 0). Double-gates the tag-side per-response dwt_readdiagnostics + LDE_THRESH + AGC_STAT1 reads in the RX collector
changes.evidence: THE tag-side ge7/ge8 regression (DOMINANT regressor). REGRESSION_REPORT.md: TAG_RX_ENABLE=1 gates dwt_readdiagnostics(~5-6 SPI) + rf_diag_from_rxdiag (LDE_THRESH+AGC_STAT1, 2 SPI) = ~55-90us @8MHz inside the single-buffer collector before RX re-arm -> straddles the next reply -> drops every other anchor -> even/odd, exactly 4 valid. Measured A/B (60s, fixed rig): DIAG OFF ge7=0.978/ge8=0.932 {7:76,8:1544}; DIAG ON ge7=0.0/ge8=0.0 {4:1409} (odd anchors 0%). Fix = runtime DIAG gate default OFF. CMake comment: 'disabled by default to protect ranging success.'

changes.default: OFF (no write until commanded; production = MAX)
changes.evidence: Power proven IRRELEVANT: ge7 flat 0.978 / bias swing 17.7-18.9mm across full 8.5dB incl M12 floor; 'AGC fully normalizes power end-to-end' (logs/overnight_power_20260714/REPORT.md, logs/overnight_power_position_high_20260715/REPORT.md+COMPARISON.md). Keep as diag knob, lock MAX in production.

changes.change: In apply_txrf_and_diag(): EVC_EN (DIG_DIAG event counters) + clear AGC_CTRL1 DIS_AM so AGC_STAT1 populates each RX; read_dw1000_event_counters/temperature helpers; boot readback log
changes.evidence: Diagnostic-support bundled with the P0 fix (T1). Per the evidence agent, the AGC_CTRL1 DIS_AM clear is the GENUINE functional correction in the whole P0 bundle (without it 'the tag-local agc_stat1 diag reads 0'; dwt_configure writes AGC_TUNE1/2 but never AGC_CTRL1). One-time writes at radio config, negligible per-frame cost; DIS_AM clear is also a benign/standard RX setting. OPEN ITEM: diagnostic-motivated; operator may keep (benign) or strip EVC_EN/DIS_AM for a strictly-minimal config. dwt_configuretxrf (T1) is the KEEP.

changes.change: V2/V3 diag response payload + fixeda19 deferral knobs: APP_ANCHOR_RESP_PAYLOAD_DIAG_V2_ENABLE + SKIP_RANK0 + RANK0_FAST_TX + POST_TX_DIAG_READ + POST_TX_DIAG_PAYLOAD_DELAY + POST_TX_DIAG_SIDECHANNEL (all default 0); ss_twr_resp_write_diag_v2, print_post_tx_diag, pipelined post-TX dwt_readdiagnostics
changes.evidence: THE fixeda19 fix (SECONDARY ge7 regressor when its flags are dropped to 0). Comment: 'fixed-a19 (ALL ranks): NEVER read diagnostics before starttx. The pre-TX dwt_readdiagnostics (~55-90us @8MHz SPI) was busting the delayed-TX deadline (~50% coin-flip). Moved AFTER starttx, pipelined into the NEXT response.' PROXY_DIAGON_A19_HANDOFF_20260630.md + REGRESSION_REPORT.md 2A/2C. NOTE the polarity: the CURRENT production anchor build (altbcast-fixeda19-p0txpwr) sets V2_ENABLE + POST_TX_DIAG_READ + POST_TX_DIAG_PAYLOAD_DELAY = 1 (deferred-diag ON, safe); the source #ifndef DEFAULTS are 0. Both configs range fine (flags=0 -> V1 no-diag = a18 timing; flags=1 -> V3 post-TX deferred = fixed-a19). The 07-14 collapse was flags dropped to 0 WHILE the tag had TAG_RX_ENABLE=1; the standalone-safe production choice is flags=1 (deferred) OR fully off.

changes.evidence: Anchor CIR capture for the listener-proxy/imaging experiments. Mode-gated OFF. Responder read is post-TX (after reply, no deadline). Chunked dwt_readaccdata <=48B.

open_items_for_operator: T17 Tier-2 phase telemetry (TP/TQ): default ON, CPU-only hooks in the tag RX collector spin loop. Negligible (no SPI) but resident in the hot path. Confirm keep-on or gate behind the DIAG flag for a pristine freeze.
T19 tag temp/vbat ;T trailer: UNCONDITIONAL (no compile/runtime flag), ~1ms once/30s at radio-idle. Confirm keep or gate.

T20/A12 EVC_EN + AGC_CTRL1 DIS_AM clear: diagnostic-support one-time writes bundled with the required P0 dwt_configuretxrf. Benign; confirm keep or strip for a strictly-minimal radio config. (The dwt_configuretxrf itself is a required KEEP.)
A13 matrix/AutoPos unconditional dwt_readdiagnostics: feeds the gated CIR publish, runs only in AutoPos (no ranging-deadline). Confirm keep or gate.

T25 RXAUTR/RXDBLBUF falsified experiments: inert (compile flags = 0). Zero-risk to leave (documented dead-ends) or strip. Not runtime-toggleable, so does not meet the RUNTIME-DEBUG 'toggleable' bar — classed USELESS.
TXPWR (T14/A9): retained as a diagnostic knob but MUST be locked to MAX in the production/frozen config (power proven irrelevant to accuracy; MAX = max link-margin headroom, costs nothing).

P0 TX-RF (T1/A1): two prior register audits DISAGREE on severity (2026-07-06 DW1000_REGISTER_AUDIT = CRITICAL; 2026-07-10 science_audit = POR values already acceptable). The ge7 report clears P0 of the regression and no ranging A/B gain nor boot-readback log exists. Recommend KEEP (init-only, deterministic register state, carries the DIS_AM fix) but record it as benign-tidy, not a proven bugfix. Optionally capture a boot-readback log (logs/p0txrf_bootreadback is empty) during the freeze build to document POR->written values.

ANCHOR fixeda19 flag polarity (A7): the deployed production marker altbcast-fixeda19-p0txpwr builds with V2_ENABLE + POST_TX_DIAG_READ + POST_TX_DIAG_PAYLOAD_DELAY = 1 (V3 36-byte response, post-TX deferred diag, adds anchor delta-P) — while the SOURCE #ifndef defaults are 0 (V1 20-byte, no diag = strict a18 airtime). Both are validated ge7>=0.96 (deferred read is timing-safe). FREEZE DECISION: build the anchor with flags=1 (current fixeda19, keeps anchor delta-P) or flags=0 (pure a18 V1, no delta-P). Whichever is chosen, the tag DIAG gate (T13) must stay OFF.
